name: Play-first: MINNEN along the top wall, BESTÅ storage over the dresser and play table, TROFAST divider, reading corner by the window
notes:
Alternative, re-checked 2026-10-23: play-first, the bed along the top wall so the middle stays open. Two changes: the TROFAST out of the slot in front of the heater to a low divider facing the play floor, and the BESTÅ unit on the empty wall above the dresser and the play table (F-63). 12 placed, 9 extras.
bed-1 MINNEN (fully extended) along the top wall, head on the left wall, flush on both: F-34 its open side faces the room, clear from the dresser to the foot (x 17 to 77.5) down to the rug; F-33 bedding (the foot) 34.5" from the heater face.
dresser-1 GODISHUS on the left wall at the bed's head, the bedside table; drawers face the room: F-32 24" clear (x 16.9 to 40.9, open floor); F-21 anchor it (IKEA).
table-1 LÄTT against the left wall by the door, its two chairs side by side on its open side (x 19 to 30); 1.25" short of the door's swing (F-31), so the door still opens flat against the left wall. Flag: assumed-position:door.
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): left wall above the dresser and the play table, rot 270, x 0-16.5, y 41-88.25, starting at the bed's head edge, never over the bed: closed storage hung above her reach for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass, F-21) hangs between the table and the cabinet.
toys-1 TROFAST as a low divider, rot 180, x 66.4-103, y 77.1-94.5, boxes facing the play floor: its back on the closet doors' swing line without entering it, the 24" in front of the closet clear (F-31); F-32 36.6" in front of the boxes to the bed; its end 9" from the heater face (F-33), with no open back toward the heater. Flag: assumed-position:closet.
books-1 FLISAT book display in the window corner on the top wall, covers facing the room, right end 12.75" from the heater face (F-33): the reading corner, with the SKOGSDUVA floor cushions (extras) in front and canopy-1 LÖVA over it on the top wall, its right edge 12" from the heater face (F-33: textiles), mounted out of reach (IKEA).
rug-1 VALLABY rot 0, x 24-63, y 40-92: the open play floor; 0.5" of it slips under the bed's long rail (no legs there), it ends at the door's swing line, and it is 49" from the heater face.
lamp-1 UPPLYST on the left wall over the bed's head, cord fastened. nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER and plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the dresser.
Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored (the GODISHUS carries IKEA's anchor warning at 23 5/8", so it is anchored too); no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk.
Walkways (F-30): door to room 36.4" between the play chairs and the TROFAST; middle to the reading corner 34.5" between the bed's foot and the heater face, 36.6" between the bed and the TROFAST.
Extras: VIMSIG mattress and BARNDRÖM fitted sheet in the frame, SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2 in the reading corner, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: nothing.
Total $1,114.31: placed $742.89 + extras $371.42; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
